About The Company

Our client is a US-based software aggregator that leverages AI and machine learning to build scalable, intelligent solutions.

About The Role

Our client is seeking an AI / Machine Learning Engineer who is passionate about designing, building, and deploying data-driven models into real-world applications. In this role, you will work on developing, training, and optimizing machine learning models, while collaborating closely with software engineers to integrate AI solutions into production systems.

Responsibilities

• Design, build, train, and evaluate machine learning and AI models for real-world use cases.
• Work with structured and unstructured data to develop predictive, classification, or generative models.
• Develop and maintain data pipelines for data collection, preprocessing, and feature engineering.
• Deploy machine learning models into production environments and monitor their performance.
• Optimize models for accuracy, scalability, and efficiency.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, data) to translate business needs into AI solutions.
• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Warp, etc.) to improve development speed and code quality.

Qualifications

• Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in AI, Machine Learning, or Data Science roles.
• Excellent English communication skills.
• Strong proficiency in Python and common ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, or similar).
• Familiarity with deploying ML models in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar).
• Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional team.
• Experience using AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Warp) is a strong plus.
• Indonesian Citizen.

If you thrive in a demanding, fast-paced environment and are eager to work on impactful AI-driven products, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

rows.jd_text:
Data Scientist - Jakarta - WFO (ID: 707131)

Position: Data Scientist
Employment Type: Contract-Based
Work Location: Jakarta
Work Arrangement: Full Work From Office (WFO)
Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Informatics Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in Data Engineering or Data Integration, with proven experience in migrating unstructured data (Excel/CSV) into centralized relational databases.
• Hands-on experience in designing and developing large-scale (enterprise-level) ETL/ELT solutions.
• Strong expertise in Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL, including Stored Procedures, Indexing, Query Optimization, and complex SQL development.
• Proficient in writing advanced SQL queries for large-scale data processing and transformation.
• Strong Python programming skills for data processing and automation, particularly using Pandas, NumPy, and related integration frameworks.
• Experience in consuming and developing RESTful APIs.
• Solid experience with ETL tools such as Talend (preferred) or SSIS.
• Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow for scheduling and managing data pipelines.
• Good understanding of Data Warehousing concepts, including Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, and Data Modeling.
• Knowledge of Data Governance practices, including Data Lineage, Data Cataloging, Metadata Management, and automated data quality validation.
Nice to Have
• Experience with Robotic Process Automation (RPA) tools such as UiPath, Power Automate, Selenium, Playwright, or similar technologies for automating repetitive business processes.
• Familiarity with modern Data Cataloging platforms such as OpenMetadata, DataHub, or equivalent tools.
• Understanding of real-time data architectures and streaming technologies such as Kafka or Spark Streaming.
• Relevant professional certifications, such as Talend Certified Developer, Microsoft SQL Server Certification, or other related certifications.

About the company

The client is a leading life insurer in Malaysia going through a Digital Transformation. They need a highly skilled Data Scientist to join their team to build traditional ML models to improve insurance day to day business operations.

Key Responsibilities • End-to-End Model Development: Design, build, evaluate, and deploy predictive models using supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.

• Predictive & Time Series Modeling: Develop time series forecasting and regression models to predict business outcomes, trends, and demand patterns.

• Anomaly Detection & Classification: Build algorithms to detect operational anomalies, fraud, or system outliers while refining classification workflows.

• Pipeline & Feature Engineering: Write clean, modular Python and SQL scripts to clean, transform, and extract high-value features from complex structured and unstructured datasets.

• Framework Implementation: Leverage TensorFlow, PyTorch, and XGBoost to train, tune, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models for production readiness.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Translate complex business questions into quantitative frameworks and present analytical findings directly to technical leads and executive business stakeholders.

Qualifications• 4+ years of professional experience in a Data Scientist role, delivering end-to-end machine learning solutions in production environments.

• Strong business acumen with a proven track record of translating business requirements into technical data science problems.

• Solid background in model evaluation, hyperparameter tuning, and model lifecycle management.

Key Skills Required• Core Machine Learning: Predictive Analytics, Regression, Time Series Analysis, Classification, Supervised & Unsupervised Learning, Anomaly Detection.

• Frameworks & Libraries: TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, Scikit-Learn.

• Programming & Database: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.

Our client is the market leader in their industry. As part of their plan to invest in technology, they are now hiring a new team member to be based here in their Headquarters here in Singapore.

• Write clean, maintainable, and production-ready code utilizing Python.

• Translate and present complex analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders to influence key business decisions.
• Provide technical mentorship to junior data scientists and actively evaluate emerging research to improve internal methodologies.

rows.jd_text:
• *Backend Engineer (Python)**

Contract: 3 Months

Onsite – Gatot Subroto, Jakarta Selatan

Mencari Backend Engineer dengan pengalaman 2–4 tahun yang kuat di Python untuk membangun dan memelihara REST API serta service berskala production. Diutamakan kandidat yang punya pengalaman di industri banking/financial services atau pernah menangani project untuk klien perbankan, karena project ini menuntut pemahaman terhadap sistem dengan tingkat keamanan, akurasi data, dan compliance yang tinggi.
• *Requirement / Kualifikasi**

Wajib (Must-have):

- Min. 2–4 tahun pengalaman sebagai Backend Engineer / Software Engineer dengan fokus Python

- Python tingkat mahir — OOP, clean code, unit testing

- Pengalaman membangun REST API dengan FastAPI, Django REST Framework, atau Flask

- Menguasai SQL dan database relational (PostgreSQL/MySQL) — query optimization, indexing, transaction

- Memahami konsep authentication & authorization (JWT, OAuth2), API security, dan validasi input

- Pengalaman integrasi third-party API / service-to-service integration

- Familiar dengan Git workflow dan code review

- Pengalaman deploy aplikasi ke environment production (Docker menjadi nilai tambah besar)

- Pendidikan min. S1 Teknik Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait

- Bahasa Inggris pasif-aktif

Nilai Tambah (Nice-to-have):

- **Pengalaman kerja di industri banking/financial services** (in-house di bank, fintech, payment gateway, atau project untuk klien perbankan) — is a plus

- Familiar dengan use case perbankan: core banking integration, payment/transfer flow, transaction reconciliation, loan origination, atau KYC/AML process

- Pemahaman sensitivitas data nasabah, data masking/encryption, audit trail, dan prinsip compliance di industri keuangan (POJK/PDP, PCI-DSS)

- Pengalaman dengan message broker / async processing: Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery, Redis

- Pengalaman microservices architecture dan API gateway

- Familiar CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) dan monitoring/logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)

- Familiar cloud platform: AWS, GCP, atau Azure

- Pengalaman NoSQL (MongoDB) dan caching strategy

- Kontribusi open-source atau portfolio GitHub

- Sertifikasi terkait cloud/backend development
• *Job Description / Tanggung Jawab**

- Merancang, mengembangkan, dan memelihara REST API serta backend service menggunakan Python

- Melakukan integrasi dengan sistem internal maupun third-party API sesuai kebutuhan project

- Merancang skema database, menulis query yang efisien, dan menjaga integritas data

- Menerapkan standar keamanan aplikasi: autentikasi, otorisasi, enkripsi data sensitif, dan audit logging

- Melakukan unit testing dan integration testing untuk memastikan kualitas kode

- Melakukan debugging, troubleshooting, dan optimasi performa service di production

- Berkolaborasi dengan Frontend Engineer, Data/AI Engineer, QA, dan Product Team

- Mendokumentasikan API (OpenAPI/Swagger), arsitektur, dan flow sistem secara rapi

- Mengikuti best practice version control (Git), code review, dan CI/CD
